note: T-276: border factors for the joint commute gravity (sim/src/bin/joint_gravity.rs) between zones of two packs. A pair of regions held by one pack takes that pack's own factor (its gravity block's border_factor); other pairs within a country (the line between two packs) take admin1_default, else pack_line_default (0.5 since T-1163, Anita 2026-10-24; 0.4 before, Japan's fit, the default for a country with no fit of its own, Anita 2026-10-16, T-584; before that no factor, T-181); pairs across a national border take national["A|B"] (alphabetical ISO 3166 codes) or national_default. US 0.23: the US packs' fit on LODES (T-162, T-198), unchanged by T-1163. JP 0.5 (T-1163, with pack_line_default): fitted at 0.4 between Japanese packs so the commuters between packs matched the 2020 census's between the same prefectures less telework (T-463; at 1 the model sent 1.9 times the census); prefecture lines inside a pack take no factor (T-420). seamless: pairs of packs whose line runs through one continuous city take their own factor, from the line's ordinary one up to 1 (T-1192, Anita 2026-10-24; written by pipeline/seams.py, rerun after a replan or a change of the defaults; km: line through city, side: the shared city's people on the smaller side). Everyday outings across a line inside a country take no factor (T-1175, bin/cross_everyday.rs); across a national border the national one. US-Canada 0.05: judgement, few thousand commute between Windsor and Detroit where a plain gravity would send several times more; fit it on census flows when a zone pair across the border is built. MY-SG 0.5 (T-1738): Johor Bahru sends about 250,000-400,000 workers a day into Singapore (news estimates, no census), more than most lines inside a country, so the pack line default; checked against the joint solve's flows in notes/T-1738.md. BY-UA and RU-UA 0 (T-2344): closed to crossings since 2022, Crimea's line with them. DZ-MA 0 (T-2954): the land border closed since 1994. IL-PS 0.01 (T-2964, Anita 2026-11-10: "pretty closed, and come back to it later"): most West Bank work permits suspended since October 2023; the line runs through Jerusalem. KP-KR 0 (T-3287): the DMZ, closed; North Korea and China take the default. CN-HK 0.05 (T-3484, Anita 2026-11-16): the default, written in on purpose: it gives about 595,000 Hong Kong-Shenzhen crossings a weekday against 542,000-606,000 counted by the Immigration Department, so raising it would overshoot. MF-SX 0.5 (T-3762): Saint-Martin and Sint Maarten share one small island with no border controls, one town across the line, so the pack line default. IN-PK 0 (T-3764): no everyday crossing; Attari-Wagah, the one road crossing, carries no commuters and the Line of Control in Kashmir is closed. AM-AZ and AM-TR 0 (T-3764): closed since the early 1990s (Nakhchivan included). AZ-GE and AZ-RU 0 (T-3764): Azerbaijan has kept its land borders closed to people since March 2020; AZ-IR and AZ-TR keep the default for Nakhchivan's crossings. Revisit when they reopen.
